# Copilot Instructions

## Project Context
- Briefly describe the current goal and the desired outcome.
- List relevant dependencies or external services.

## Code Style
- Note specific conventions (formatting, linters, naming).
- Indicate when comments are preferred and in which cases.

## Constraints
- Mention execution time limits, memory caps, or other technical bounds.
- List files or folders that must not be modified.

## Workflow
- Explain how to validate changes (tests, lint, builds).
- Detail deployment steps if they apply.

## Additional Notes
- Add reminders for documentation or communication.
- Include useful links or internal references.
